practice_sets.unit_title: Mathematical Habits, Place Value, and Rounding

fluency_practice.target: Add and subtract within 1,000 using place-value strategies and algorithms.
fluency_practice.timing_policy: Untimed by default. Timers stay hidden or off. Speed is never scored and is never reported to a parent or guardian as a result.
fluency_practice.stop_rule: Stop the set early if accuracy drops below roughly half; that is a signal to reteach, not to continue practicing an error.

retrieval_practice.format: Two or three items from each listed earlier unit, mixed with current-unit items.
retrieval_practice.purpose: Spacing and interleaving build durable retrieval; this is not a graded quiz.

application_practice.format: One or two multi-step problems set in a realistic situation.
application_practice.requirement: The learner records the model or process, not only the answer.

prerequisite_practice.note: Assign only when a gap is observed. Do not pre-assign as a default workload.

practice_sets.accessibility: Quantity may be reduced without changing the target. Any item may be answered orally, in writing, by drawing, or by building with objects.
practice_sets.no_media_path: All practice is text and object based. No image, audio, or video is required.
